_doc: CDD engine contract lexicon — the single vocabulary source for the command contract (C6): the status-value vocab plus its dual-axis mapping, the stdout contract tokens (capsule + route anchors + the banned old-shape names), the G2 residue ban table, and the skill-anatomy schema reference. The harness contract data (rows / markers / refs) lives in the engine harness contract (config/harness-contract.json — the unique harness contract, C8); this file keeps the pure word tables. Ships to consumers via the build mirror entry (dist/config/contract-lexicon.json, same pipeline and cadence as the harness contract).
